messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: latent change score error
parts:
Hi Ed

When I try to estimate a latent change score model I get an error about a problem with the JAGS syntax, I imagine is due to the number of constraints.
The model works fine just with lavaan

Here is the sample code and error

Thanks

m1 <- '
change_t2 =~ 1*tot_2
tot_2 ~ 1*tot_1
tot_2 ~~ 0*tot_2
tot_2 ~0*1

change_t2 ~~ vch2*change_t2
change_t2 ~mch2*1

change_t1 =~ 1*tot_1
tot_1 ~ 1*tot_0
tot_1 ~~ 0*tot_1
tot_1 ~0*1

change_t1 ~~ vch1*change_t1
change_t1 ~mch1*1

## choen d
ch1 := mch1/sqrt(vch1)
ch2 := mch2/sqrt(vch2)
'

fit1 <- bcfa(m1, data=dat, std.lv=F,
             n.chains = 3, 
             burnin=5000, sample=3000, adapt=3000)


Error in dump.format(arg[[c]], checkvalid = TRUE) : 
  The following problem was identified in the data provided:  invalid variable value(s) - parvec (character)
Error in blavaan(m1, data = dat, std.lv = F, n.chains = 3, burnin = 5000,  : 
  blavaan ERROR: problem with MCMC estimation.  The model syntax and data have been exported.
